reportInputs.basis.WorkloadPeopleContext: Tasks assigned to people in this report scope, including their other visible disciplines. A task can appear in both counts.
reportInputs.basis.PlannerPeopleContext: Tasks assigned to people represented in this report scope; task context is separate from planning-entry source and confidence. A task can appear in both counts.
reportInputs.basis.CurrentRecordedTaskCo: Current inputs for distinct tasks referenced by permitted time entries. Recorded hours stay separate; a task can appear in both counts.
reportInputs.visibleOnly: Only task records you may view in this report scope are counted.
reportInputs.unavailableReferences: Recorded task references with unavailable current inputs: {n}. Matching counts retain their known subtotal.
reportInputs.noneKnown: No known matching current tasks in this report scope
